name: Storm Burger
facts: Storm Burger (StormBurger) has locations in Inglewood and Long Beach; Compton is coming soon.
Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.
Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Open Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.
Compton (coming soon): 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220.
Storm Run is a free 45-second driving game with 5 lives.
Every hit costs half a life, so 10 hits end the run.
Weekly prize board resets every Monday; top score by Sunday close wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.
Game prizes: 400 = free house sauce, 600 = free fries or onion rings, 800 = free milkshake, 1,000 = free Classic StormBurger.
Only one game prize at a time per member; use it within 3 days.
Daily Spin is free: one spin per member per day (Los Angeles time).
Rewards points: 20 points per $1.
Reward ladder: 1,000 pts Free fries; 1,800 Free shake; 3,000 Free Classic StormBurger; 4,500 Free combo.
Check-in bonus 50 pts; first order 100 pts; birthday 200 pts; app feedback 250 pts.
Referral: you get 150 pts when a friend joins; friend gets free fries.
Account needs name, phone number and email; one account per person and phone.
Players must be 13+ (under 18 need a parent's permission).
Sauces are $1.00 each, homemade.
Combos come with fries and a soft drink.
Prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at either location.
No purchase necessary to play or win.
suggested: How do I play Storm Run?
What can I win from the game?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM, Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM. Long Beach: Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM, Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: What time does the Inglewood location open and close?
qa.a: Inglewood is open Sun–Thu 10:30 AM–12 AM and Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM.

qa.q: What time does the Long Beach location open and close?
qa.a: Long Beach is open Mon–Wed 10:30 AM–10 PM and Thu–Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: Are you open late?
qa.a: Inglewood stays open until 12 AM Sun–Thu and 1 AM Fri–Sat. Long Beach closes at 10 PM Mon–Wed and 11 PM Thu–Sun.

qa.q: Are you open on Sundays?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Sunday 10:30 AM–12 AM and Long Beach is open Sunday 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood: Fri–Sat 10:30 AM–1 AM, Sun 10:30 AM–12 AM. Long Beach: Sat and Sun 10:30 AM–11 PM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton is coming soon.

qa.q: What is the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is there a Compton location?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon, at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. It isn't open yet.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under your location in the app to open it in maps.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number for Storm Burger. Please ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: Do you have a drive-thru?
qa.a: I don't have that detail. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: Can I order online?
qa.a: Yes. The app has Order buttons for Inglewood and Long Beach, and you can build your own burger or chicken sandwich and place the order.

qa.q: How do I build my own burger?
qa.a: Open the Build tool on the menu. Tap or drag ingredients onto your burger, watch the price add up, tap Grill it, then place your order.

qa.q: Can I build a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Chicken sandwich tab in the builder and start with a hand-breaded crispy fillet or the spicy Thunder fillet.

qa.q: Can I pay in the app?
qa.a: I don't have details on paying in the app. Ask staff at the counter how to pay.

qa.q: Do you take table orders or QR codes?
qa.a: I don't have details about table ordering. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: We have combos, burgers, a chicken sandwich, a turkey burger, kids items, shakes and homemade sauces. Scroll the menu in the app to see everything with prices.

qa.q: What combos do you have?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99 and Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99. All come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: Every combo comes with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Can I upgrade my combo?
qa.a: Yes. Upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00, or your drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What is the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: A 4oz patty with homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños. It's $6.99 on its own.

qa.q: Do you have a kids meal?
qa.a: Yes. The Kids Burger (4oz patty, American cheese) is $5.99, and the Kids Combo with fries and a soft drink is $11.99.

qa.q: Do you have a turkey burger?
qa.a: Yes. Two 2oz turkey patties with lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce, $6.99.

qa.q: Do you have a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. The Chicken Sandwich Combo is $12.99 with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have shakes?
qa.a: Yes. We have vanilla, chocolate and a Mix Shake (both), which is $4.99.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Homemade sauces at $1.00 each, including Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Ask staff or see the menu for the full list.

qa.q: How much are sauces?
qa.a: $1.00 each.

qa.q: Do you have onion rings?
qa.a: Yes. You can upgrade your combo fries to onion rings for +$2.00.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol?
qa.a: I don't see alcohol in the app. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Are there vegetarian options?
qa.a: I don't have vegetarian details. Please ask staff what can be made for you.

qa.q: Do you have any specials right now?
qa.a: Holiday specials show up as a banner at the top of the app when they're running. Check the Specials card in the menu.

qa.q: What is the Thunder Night Combo?
qa.a: A Halloween special (Oct 20–31): Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo with Thunder sauce on the side.

qa.q: What is the Gobble Burger?
qa.a: A Thanksgiving-week special (Nov 20–28): Turkey Burger plus Onion Rings.

qa.q: What holiday specials are coming?
qa.a: Gobble Burger (Nov 20–28), Holiday Shake Stack (Dec 15–25), New Year BBQ Combo (Dec 29–Jan 1), Burgers for Two (Feb 7–14), Lucky Strips Combo (Mar 14–17), Cinco Spicy Combo (May 1–5) and Fourth of July Classic (Jul 1–4). Specials are shown in the app while they run.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have any happy hour info. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Sign up in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free, one account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, membership is free.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. Storm Run is free for anyone with no account. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend. You also earn bonus points for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback and referrals.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 20 points per $1 spent.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: Spend money (20 pts per $1), check in with your QR (50), place your first order (100), leave app feedback (250), have a birthday (200), refer friends, or win points on the Daily Spin.

qa.q: How do I get points when I pay?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier when you order so your purchase counts.

qa.q: Do I get points for checking in?
qa.a: Yes. You get 50 bonus points when staff scan your member QR, once per day.

qa.q: Is there a first order bonus?
qa.a: Yes, 100 bonus points on your first order.

qa.q: Do I get points for leaving feedback?
qa.a: Yes, 250 points once for honest feedback in the app, no matter the rating.

qa.q: Do I get points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. Points are only for in-app feedback, not Google or Yelp reviews.

qa.q: Do I get points for playing the game?
qa.a: I don't see points per game score. Game prizes are free food based on your score, and you can win points on the Daily Spin.

qa.q: What can I redeem my points for?
qa.a: 1,000 points = Free fries; 1,800 = Free shake; 3,000 = Free Classic StormBurger; 4,500 = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free burger?
qa.a: 3,000 points gets you a Free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Pick your reward in the app and show it at the counter. Staff will confirm it, and only one reward can be used per visit.

qa.q: Can I combine rewards?
qa.a: No. One reward per visit, and rewards can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiration details for points. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do points have cash value?
qa.a: No. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have details on membership levels. You can see your progress on your rewards card in the app.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. You get 200 bonus points for your birthday. Add your birthday when you join.

qa.q: Can I refer friends?
qa.a: Yes. Share your referral code. You get 150 points when a friend joins, and they get free fries. You earn more when they order: 100 on their first visit, then 25 each time after.

qa.q: What does my friend get if I refer them?
qa.a: Your friend gets free fries.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: The app can show how far you are and give a heads-up when you're within 2 miles. Show the nearby offer at the counter for double stars on that day's order.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member (Los Angeles time). Every slice wins something, and spins are never sold.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +100 points (30%), +200 points (20%), +150 points (15%), free house sauce (15%), $2 off any burger (8%), free fries (7%), or 10% off your order (5%).

qa.q: How do I use Daily Spin food prizes?
qa.a: They're good for 3 days at either location, one reward per visit. They have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Does buying food help me win the spin?
qa.a: No. The spin is free and a purchase doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: A free 45-second driving game. Drive the food truck through the storm, grab coins and food, and dodge lightning, cops, tornadoes, flying cows and stop signs.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Tap the left or right side of the road to change lanes, or use the ◀ ▶ buttons under the game (arrow keys on a computer).

qa.q: What are the controls?
qa.a: Tap left or right on the road, use the ◀ ▶ buttons, or press the arrow keys. You can also use a game controller.

qa.q: How long is a game and how many lives do I get?
qa.a: Each run is 45 seconds with 5 lives. Every hit costs half a life, so 10 hits end the run.

qa.q: How does scoring work?
qa.a: Coins are +10. Food is +30 to +60 (burgers +60, chicken +50, shakes and lemonade +40, fries and rings +30). Cows, stop signs and lightning cost −100 and half a life. You also score for every second on the road.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Lightning (move off the glowing target), flying cows, stop signs, drive-thru line cars, police cars that try to ram you and small tornadoes.

qa.q: How does lightning work?
qa.a: A glowing target shows where lightning will land, usually where your truck is. Change lanes in time or lose half a life.

qa.q: What is the pit stop?
qa.a: Pull into the Jordan High pit stop on the right to repair your truck. Build burgers for the kids in 20 seconds: each one earns +75 and repairs +1 life up to 5.

qa.q: What is Antidote Drizzle?
qa.a: A hidden bonus: catch 5 Antidote Drizzle emblems (+25 each) to unlock a roadside billboard with Antidote's StormBurger review. Drive through its golden ▶ for a bonus of 500.

qa.q: How often can I play the game?
qa.a: As often as you like. It's free with no limit.

qa.q: What can I win in Storm Run?
qa.a: One run over 400 = free house sauce; 600 = free fries or onion rings; 800 = free milkshake; 1,000 = free Classic StormBurger. The weekly top score wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: After your run, tap Save my prize and join with your info to get a code. Show the code on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: How long do game prizes last?
qa.a: You must use a game prize within 3 days. You can only hold one prize at a time.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. The board resets every Monday, and ties go to the score posted first.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday. The board closes Sunday at 11:00 PM Los Angeles time.

qa.q: When do I pick up my weekly prize?
qa.a: I don't have pickup timing for weekly prizes. Please ask staff.

qa.q: How do I save my score?
qa.a: After a run, tap the save prompt and join with your name, phone and email. Your best score on this phone is also shown under the game.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Do I need to buy something to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is necessary to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: Who can play?
qa.a: U.S. residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Employees can play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: I don't see a kid mode. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Xbox, PlayStation and Switch Pro controllers work in most browsers. Pair it, press any button, and use the stick or D-pad to steer.

qa.q: What are the game settings?
qa.a: In Settings you can choose 3D chase cam or Classic 2D, pick a route (Inglewood, Long Beach or both) and set graphics quality.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the 🌐 button to switch among English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified/traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Tap Add to Home Screen in the app. On iPhone use Share → Add to Home Screen; on Android tap Install or the ⋮ menu → Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't see a wallet card. You can add the app to your Home Screen so your rewards are one tap away.

qa.q: Can I text you or get texts?
qa.a: Marketing texts are optional. You can opt in when you sign up and stop anytime by replying STOP.

qa.q: How is my information used?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. You can opt out of texts and emails anytime.

qa.q: Can I write a Google review?
qa.a: Yes, honest reviews are welcome. There is a Write a Google review button in the app. No points or prizes are given for reviews.

qa.q: Where can I see your Instagram?
qa.a: Storm Burger's Instagram is @stormburger, and the app has a section with their latest posts and reels.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter at either location. I don't have a phone number to give you.

qa.q: Can I see the official game rules?
qa.a: Yes. The Official Rules link is at the bottom of the app near the game. They're currently a draft and not yet in effect.

qa.q: What's the difference between points and tokens?
qa.a: Reward points trade for food rewards. Game tokens aren't turned on right now, and Storm Run is free to play.

qa.q: Do you have halftime or trivia features?
qa.a: I don't see trivia or sports features. During longer game sessions a short break plays Antidote The Foodie's review of Storm Burger, with a button to watch the full review.
